title: Vivo’s X Fold 6 accidentally feels like a throwback
summary: The Vivo X Fold 6 launched in China in June but feels outdated by its global release as Apple and Samsung have since shifted to shorter, wider foldable designs. Its 6.51-inch standard aspect ratio cover display and visible crease place it behind current competitors.
content:
The X Fold 6 looks like foldables did three months ago.	

It's a quirk of the release calendar that when Vivo's X Fold 6 launched in China this June, it was just another foldable. Now that it's ready for its global release, the size and aspect ratio feel oddly old-fashioned.
The X Fold 6 is much the same size as Vivo's previous foldables, and most other foldables that launched before both Apple and Samsung pivoted to a shorter, wider form factor with the Z Fold 8 and iPhone Duo. The 6.51-inch cover display is in the standard smartphone 20:9 aspect ratio, opening to an almost square 8.02-inch panel. title: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
summary: Grokipedia, SpaceX AI's Wikipedia competitor, received a v0.3 redesign featuring a new logo, featured articles list, most-read tracker, and live edits page, expanding beyond its minimal previous interface.
content:
Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, recently started incorporating edits again, and today, it got some design tweaks as part of a v0.3 update, including a new logo and refreshes to its homepage and live edits page. SpaceXAI head of design Benji Taylor calls it a "newly refreshed Grokipedia."
Grokipedia's old homepage was pretty much just a logo and a search bar, but the updated homepage includes a list of featured articles, a list of the most-read articles, and a tracker showing the "latest edits."
